summary: Loads pit-crew animation MAS files. Copies the 'pitguy' path prefix into the 16-bit header, builds the season/track sub-path (base override dword_5EC3D8, component override dword_5EC420, then 'pits'), selects a 'left' or 'normal' hand variant by byte_5EA3EC, registers the assembled path, resolves the animation MAS name via sub_53CBC0, and for each of two animation name constants (byte_5CD4A4, byte_5CD490) appends '.anm' and loads the file via sub_4A22D0. If the slot count (this+0x70) is high enough, sets animation ranges with RangeProportionInitializer and stores the resulting end values at this+0x7C/this+0x80. Frees the resolved MAS object. Called by sub_4A4900.

operations.description: Zero the 16-bit header at this+0.
Copy the 'pitguy' animation path prefix aPitguycMts into this's header buffer via StringCopyWithReverse; reverse flag = (dword_7CF884 >= 1).
Call Camera(this) during setup.
Select base path: dword_5EC3D8 if nonzero else shared buffer byte_5EA438.
StringCopyWithBufferRealloc on the selected base path.
Select second path component: dword_5EC420 if nonzero else byte_5EA438, then append it with sub_5665B0.
Append the 'pits' string aPits_0 to the assembled path.
If byte_5EA3EC is set append the 'left' variant aLeft, else append the 'normal' variant aNormal_0.
Register the assembled path string via StringRegistry(byte_5EA438).
Reset a2 to 0 and resolve the animation MAS name via sub_53CBC0(&a2, aPitanimsMas); result pointer stored back into a2.
Copy the first animation name constant byte_5CD4A4 byte-by-byte into v15 until a zero terminator.
StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(v15) to make a heap copy of the first animation name.
Append the '.anm' extension aAnm to the animation name.
Load the first animation MAS via sub_4A22D0(this, v15, byte_5EA438, 0, 0).
If the slot count at this+0x70 is greater than 0.
RangeProportionInitializer on the animation data pointer *(this+0x74) with range [0.0, duration at *(this+0x74)+0x10].
Store the range end value at this+0x7C (source register v8 uninitialized in decompiler output).
Copy the second animation name constant byte_5CD490 byte-by-byte into v15 until a zero terminator.
StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(v15) to make a heap copy of the second animation name.
Append the '.anm' extension aAnm to the second animation name.
Load the second animation MAS via sub_4A22D0(this, v15, byte_5EA438, 0, 0).
If the slot count at this+0x70 is greater than 1.
Compute rangeUpper v14 = *(animData+0x2C) + *(this+0x7C), chaining the second range onto the first range end.
RangeProportionInitializer on *(animData+0x1C) with range [*(this+0x7C), v14] for the second animation.
Store the second range end value at this+0x80 (source register v12 uninitialized in decompiler output).
If the resolved MAS object a2 is nonzero, free it via PhysicsObjectLinkedListRemoval(a2).
Finalize the shared path string via StringMatchWithFlagSet(byte_5EA438).
Call ShortComputation_3fe0(this) before returning.
Return 0 to the caller sub_4A4900.
